 New video shows the frantic moments leading up to a deadly police shooting that killed a one-year-old in Senatobia, Mississippi. The family’s attorney says the child was killed when police responded to a shoplifting call about diapers. The state attorney general says the use of force was justified. NBC News’ Aaron Gilchrist has more.  Oct. 21, 2026
